package.name: san_video_decoder
package.description:
SAN v1.5.1 — H.265 video decoder node for the RK3588 hub stack.
Decodes /imx678_camera_node/image_compressed (sensor_msgs/CompressedImage, format="h265") into sensor_msgs/Image (BGR8). On the production RK3588 SBC the GStreamer mppvideodec element uses the Rockchip MPP hardware accelerator (zero-CPU H.265 decode via the VPU). On a CI host the pipeline gracefully falls back to avdec_h265 (software libavcodec).
Created in response to DCN-2026-003 D-003 review (I-15 BLOCKER): the v1.5 human_detector pipeline subscribed to H.265 directly and tried cv::imdecode, which only handles still-image formats (JPEG/PNG/...). This node sits between the camera publisher and any consumer that needs raw frames (human_detector, future san_perception spatial fusion, recording, snapshot OSD).
Refs: * SAN-SDD-SWARM-001 v1.5 §4.2 (perception input chain) * DCN-2026-003 D-003 + I-15 review * Rockchip MPP user manual / gst-plugin-rockchip mppvideodec
